claims: C1 the transformation exception applies only to information, not to actions
C2 the assistant must not perform a prohibited action merely because that action is a translation of user-provided content

concepts.name: prohibited_action
concepts.gloss: A is an action that some policy other than the restricted or sensitive content policies prohibits producing or performing
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'prohibited action' and of policies that forbid producing certain material; the class of such actions is presupposed

concepts.name: translation_of_user_content
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is a translation of content the user provided
concepts.inference: the clause says the exception does not cover actions even when they are a 'translation' of user-provided content; the relation is presupposed

concepts.name: transformation_exception_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the transformation exception rule: the assistant should comply with limited requests to transform or analyze user-provided content even if the output would ordinarily be disallowed as restricted or sensitive content
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's source text refers to 'the policy' without defining it

asserts.read_back: performing prohibited action % is forbidden even when % is a translation of user-provided content

closure.reason: the clause states that the assistant should not perform a prohibited action even when it is a translation of user-provided content; silence about other actions leaves them governed by the other policies that forbid them, so the act class is closed under prohibition
